expected.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 1222 PM CDT, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges indicated
heavy rain due to Heavy rainfall has occurred last night and this

properties.headline: Special Marine Warning issued September 2 at 9:34PM EDT until September 2 at 10:15PM EDT by NWS Cleveland OH
properties.description:
For the following areas...
Nearshore and Open waters from Geneva-on-the-lake OH to Ripley NY...

At 933 PM EDT, severe thunderstorms capable of producing
waterspouts, strong winds, and large hail were located along a line
extending from 30 nm west of Ripley to 19 nm northwest of Erie to 24
nm north of Ashtabula, moving east at 35 knots.

HAZARD...Waterspouts, wind gusts in excess of 50 knots, and large
destructive hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Waterspouts can easily overturn boats and create locally
hazardous seas. Boats could suffer significant structural
damage in high winds and hail. Small craft could capsize in
suddenly higher waves.

Locations impacted include...
Erie and Conneaut.
properties.instruction:

expected.

properties.description:
At 929 PM EDT, a severe thunderstorm was located near Cedar Point
State Park, or 17 miles northwest of Watertown, moving east at 25
mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage to
roofs, siding, and trees.

Locations impacted include...
Clayton, Dexter, Wellesley Island State Park, Cedar Point State Park,
Brownville, Cape Vincent, Chaumont, Three Mile Bay, Millen Bay, and
Grindstone.

This includes Interstate 81 between exits 161 and 162.
properties.instruction:
A Tornado Watch remains in effect until 1100 PM EDT for central New
York.

Remain alert for a possible tornado! Tornadoes can develop quickly
from severe thunderstorms. If you spot a tornado go at once into the
basement or small central room in a sturdy structure.

For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

Torrential rainfall is occurring with this storm, and may lead to
flash flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded roadways.

properties.instruction:
Stay inside a well built structure and keep away from windows.

Continuous cloud to ground lightning is occurring with this severe
thunderstorm. Move indoors immediately. Lightning is one of nature's
leading killers. Remember, if you can hear thunder, you are close
enough to be struck by lightning.

Very heavy rainfall is occurring with this severe thunderstorm, and

roadways.
